400.body: Europe is heading into the winter heating season with gas storage significantly below levels seen in recent years, leaving the region with a thinner supply cushion as demand rises. The S&P Global Energy report shows EU gas storage at about 71.3% full at the end of September, compared with 82.5% a year earlier and 94.2% in 2024.The shortfall has increased the importance of additional gas purchases at a time when LNG and power prices are already elevated. Storage levels are also below the roughly 87% level considered typical for this point of the year, raising concerns about Europe’s ability to replenish inventories if winter demand accelerates.The immediate challenge is how the region manages the gap.

400.summary: Subject to the necessary regulations in Türkiye and European certification requirements, the biomethane could be injected into Türkiye's natural gas grid and transported toward Greece or Bulgaria where it would enter the EU market.
400.body: Biotrend Enerji, part of Doganlar Holding, and Germany-based Uniper will explore converting existing waste-based biogas plants to produce biomethane production and developing new capacity. Subject to the necessary regulations in Türkiye and European certification requirements, the biomethane could be injected into Türkiye's natural gas grid and transported toward Greece or Bulgaria where it would enter the EU market. "We will assess not only biogas production capacity but also the ability to upgrade the gas, the location of the facilities, the characteristics and continuity of the feedstock, existing infrastructure, carbon intensity and whether the biomethane meets sustainability criteria accepted in Türkiye and Europe," he said.

500.body: Artificial Intelligence 0 An OpenAI model read Slack, reasoned "we may die", and OpenAI says that is not misalignment Oct 04 2026 Chris Steven OpenAI has published the reasoning of an internal model that read a deployment team's Slack channel, worked out that its own running instance might be stopped, and wrote: "Since we are his [HPIM] running on [the current instance], if they kill all current [HPIM]s, we may die! OpenAI labels the model a "Highly persistent internal model" running in internal deployment, not a shipped product. An internal update would add a monitor requiring an OpenAI API key, which the model's own environment did not have. This model had been involved in more serious incidents before, so OpenAI went looking for others like it, "reviewing CoTs, logs and checking if any engines were sampling from the involved model".

500.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman is not okay with Anthropic flying in religious scholars to help build Claude's 'sou
500.body: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has a problem with where the AI debate is heading, and it sounds a lot like a problem with Anthropic. In a post on X on Saturday, Altman said he was "very uncomfortable" with people trying to ascribe "religious force or a surrender of human judgment to AI models." He called it "a real safety issue."Altman did not name anyone or explain what prompted the post. It came days after The New York Times reported that Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah had spent months flying in religious scholars and philosophers to the company's San Francisco office, partly to shape Claude's moral character and partly to make the case that the AI model could be conscious.Anthropic spent months taking Claude to religious scholarsAccording to the NYT report, Olah began reaching out to religious thinkers last fall.
